desc: The Tipton Compact Range Vise is a compact design for a convenient solution to gun cleaning at the range. It securely holds the widest array of guns possible while collapsing to fit in a range bag. Made form high-quality, solvent resistant polymer that will deliver years of lasting performance. Two non-marring forks protect your guns finish while holding them securely in place for cleaning or light maintenance. The Compact Range Vise is 1/4" and when expanded it measures 17 3/4" and collapses to 11". Six rubber feet provides the vise with a very rigid, non-slip base.
